rows.aname: จำนวนครั้งของผู้ป่วยโรคเบาหวานที่ได้รับการตรวจ LDL-Cholesterol ซ้ำภายใน 90 วัน
rows.bname: จำนวนครั้งของผู้ป่วยโรคเบาหวานที่ได้รับการตรวจ LDL-Cholesterol ทั้งหมด
rows.notice:
1) หากมีการตรวจ LDL-Cholesterol ซ้ำภายใน 90 วัน ให้นับเป็น จำนวนครั้ง
2) การนับว่ามีการตรวจ LDL-Cholesterol ซ้ำภายใน 90 วันหรือไม่ ให้นับย้อนหลังในช่วง 90 วันโดยอาจเป็นปีงบประมาณเดียวกันหรือ ปีงบประมาณก่อนหน้า

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code, h.zone_name as areaname, sum(b) as b, sum(a) as a, sum(b1) as b1, sum(a1) as a1, sum(b2) as b2, sum(a2) as a2, sum(b3) as b3, sum(a3) as a3, sum(b4) as b4, sum(a4) as a4 FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s join chospital_regis as h on s.hospcode = h.hoscode left join ccmihosp on ccmihosp.hcode = h.hoscode and ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} where s.b_year = {{YEAR}} and {{ZONE_CODE}} in (h.zone_code, 'ALL') and {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} in (h.dep, 'ALL') and {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} in (ccmihosp.splevel, 'ALL') and {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.tmb_code, 'ALL') and {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.amp_code, 'ALL') and {{PROVINCE_CODE}} in (h.chw_code, 'ALL') AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) group by h.zone_code, h.zone_name order by h.zone_code

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode, h.hosname as areaname, sum(b) as b, sum(a) as a, sum(b1) as b1, sum(a1) as a1, sum(b2) as b2, sum(a2) as a2, sum(b3) as b3, sum(a3) as a3, sum(b4) as b4, sum(a4) as a4 FROM chospital_regis as h left join {{S_TABLE}} as s on s.hospcode = h.hoscode and s.b_year = {{YEAR}} left join ccmihosp on ccmihosp.hcode = h.hoscode and ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} where h.hdc_regist =1 and {{ZONE_CODE}} in (h.zone_code, 'ALL') and {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} in (h.dep, 'ALL') and {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} in (ccmihosp.splevel, 'ALL') and {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.tmb_code, 'ALL') and {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.amp_code, 'ALL') and {{PROVINCE_CODE}} in (h.chw_code, 'ALL') AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) and h.hostype IN ('05', '06', '07', '11', '12', '15') group by h.hoscode, h.hosname

provider.label: หน่วยบริการ

cup.label: เครือข่ายบริการ
cup.query: SELECT concat('CUP:', m.hmainname) as areaname, sum(b) as b, sum(a) as a, sum(b1) as b1, sum(a1) as a1, sum(b2) as b2, sum(a2) as a2, sum(b3) as b3, sum(a3) as a3, sum(b4) as b4, sum(a4) as a4 FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s join chospital_regis as h on s.hospcode = h.hoscode left join ccmihosp on ccmihosp.hcode = h.hoscode and ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} JOIN cmastercup as m ON s.hospcode = m.hsub where s.b_year = {{YEAR}} and {{ZONE_CODE}} in (h.zone_code, 'ALL') and {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} in (h.dep, 'ALL') and {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} in (ccmihosp.splevel, 'ALL') and {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.tmb_code, 'ALL') and {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.amp_code, 'ALL') and {{PROVINCE_CODE}} in (h.chw_code, 'ALL') AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) GROUP BY m.hmain, m.hmainname ORDER BY m.hmain
